dog.description_text:
Star Spangled (aka Star) is a very sweet and tender soul. She settled into her foster home very quickly, became fast friends with our resident dog, and wins over anyone she meets in no time.

She’s a very chill puppy who loves a good play session and will nap peacefully once she’s all tired out. She’s been making great progress using her pee pad and is generally a quick learner. She was terrified of the elevator in the morning, and walked in and out like she owned the place by evening.

She spends the night in her crate but loves some good morning snuggles. She’s very affectionate and melts right into your arms.

She’s a great city pup, getting more confident every day. She loves long walks to the park, walks over grates without flinching, and is a perfect cafe buddy. She loves to curl up under the table and people watch. She’s doing well on leash and stays calm when encountering other dogs.

She a perfect, active, playful, and loving companion!
dog.name: Star Spangled
